known_limitations: Standalone B-sleeve screen only; no portfolio integration was attempted after the screen failed.
Core earnings coverage is 92.0%-95.5% among B candidates; missing values fail the gate.
Financial statements are current snapshots with restatement risk; announcement dates are normalized PIT dates.
B standalone drawdowns are intentionally reported before portfolio risk budgeting and are not comparable to the final three-sleeve portfolio MDD.
negative_knowledge: The core-earnings gate does not transfer from A to B: it improved 2023 but hurt 2022, recent-year and long-run returns.
A near-zero 5x net profit amplified concentration ratios, and the gate also reduced distinct symbols versus B control.
Do not test the factor on C, scan its threshold, change profit definitions or reweight the B sleeve.
